div.head: Nuts
div.p:
Crazy as a cashew.
Unbelievably lucky,

Always the same old job,
17 years of it.
Sheer luxury.

div.head: Shame
div.p: They got to me.

They drove me
off the deep end.

div.head: Dreaming of dreaming with my cat.
div.p: (Dedicated to Go the cat)

Early this morning in bed,
I had a very pleasant dream.

lg.l: I dreamt that I was asleep
My cat came to me in a dream last night,
he needed my love and my reassurance
and he was a sook and a cuddler.
My cat came to me in a dream last night,
you see, he was killed by vicious dogs
at the front door of his home
He never did learn to fight
But he wasn’t fast enough that day,
he was getting a little old.
My cat came to me in a dream last night,
I told him I loved him and he told me the same,
for it was twenty years ago

div.head: White Space
div.p:
Here I sit,
at my word pro,

lg.l: Me, myself and I will get alone just fine.
Life in the suburbs is sedate.
how many men could I find to hate ???
It’s just how you look at it;
’cos if you don’t have the time
then you will find true peace

div.head: To have lived our fantasies
div.p:
had you really promised without thinking ???
or did your feet turn cold ???

div.head: And the Expletives Remained
div.p:
Fuck the Poetry Police!
Fuck you all, very much.

div.head: Spinning Out

lg.l: was only a couple of days ago.
" Think what you know is true."

div.p:
But then I would think,
" Well what do I know is the truth ?"

lg.l: " Is that really what you believe ?

div.p:
And then I’d have to think of
something else to believe in.

lg.l: And this was not a relaxed process.
and it seemed like an eternity.

div.head: Walls & Sledge Hammers
div.p:
I live by myself,
have a few close friends…

and they’ve been very
supportive towards me.

lg.l: in my lucky full time job
I get largely left alone and
to have a job that I’m in love with.

div.p: My career is not my life.

I have good days
and other days.
Sometimes the other days get ugly.

lg.l: But, I always try to do
to prove that I am really
and I do it the best
I just have to get help
that when I hit a wall,
they will almost always out-stare me.

div.p:
So that’s when I get a ladder,
or maybe a sledge hammer.

div.head: Knots
div.p: (Dedicated to Mistress Alexis)

knotted then back.
" Keep still, please."

I move around a little,
trying to become comfortable.

I can’t wait for my freedom,
then to do it all again.

lg.l: of the corners of my mind

div.head:
Voices again.
Been there, done that...

lg.l: the last time that I was "hearing voices"

div.p:
It was less that a week ago.
I had been there a thousand times before.

Yes, I am on medication.
Yes, I do take it regularly.

But this was only
a short lived episode.

lg.l: I hadn’t gotten dressed all day,
been napping off and on all day.
I had also done my weeks washing and
had it drying on a clothes horse

div.p:
It was early evening and
I wanted to go to sleep.

Slumber was a blissful escape,
or perhaps only sometimes.

Anyway, I couldn’t get any sleep,
and my mind was racing.

"Everyone’s going to find out
all about those secrets.

Everyone will know the
worst things that I can imagine.

lg.l: They will know all about me
people saying will be true now."

div.p: They keep on going around in my head.

lg.l: but why won’t they go away ?
But you know what to do,

div.p: The vicious circle kept going ‘round.

div.p:
Scattered and shaking,
I do this.
She is my tower of strength.

It’s an STD call
but I don’t care.

lg.l: She tells me to ring the Crisis Team
but I can only fumble with
I know exactly how it works,

I get a pen and Mum tells me

I hang up the phone and

My mini-crisis passes

div.head: Hollywood Romantiks

lg.l: Why doesn’t it happen to me ?"

div.p:
It doesn’t happen to me either!
Life is not a fairy tale.

And yet love will happen.
Of that I’m sure.

div.head: Are we there yet ?
div.p:
I should:
take my own advice.

lg.l: Don’t I always try to think
of what I’m going to say next,
before I commit it to paper ?
How will I know when I’m there ?"

div.p: "Are we there yet ?"

div.head: It didn’t really happen
div.p:
You went down the street
just an ordinary day

their freezer needed defrosting
happens everyday

lg.l: or did you just dream it
how to make a little… tiny… flame thrower ???
from an aerosol can and a flame

div.p:
and she could even reach that freezer
if she just stands on a chair

lg.l: try living with the memory of that scared little face
it didn’t really happen at all, did it ?

div.p:
just keep telling yourself
it was all just a bad, bad dream.

div.head: Lust
div.p:
and did I crave for her ?
lust for her ?
desires for her ?

why, no.
You do believe me, don’t you ?

div.head: Looking Good
div.p: a cute arse!

lg.l: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear,
oh dear, oh dear, oh dear.
It’s good to have some real work to do.
I do indeed lead a lucky life.
After all, I have a job
to do a good and honest job.
of knowing that I will live

div.head: Perhaps
div.p:
Do I believe in God ?
That depends on what you mean by God.

lg.l: Do I believe in life after death ?
That depends how you define life,
I don’t know how you define a soul,
but I suspect that I do.

div.p:
I believe that there is something to look forward to
after death.

I believe that in some way, in some "place" the
souls of "good men" end up and exist together.

lg.l: I don’t know what or where it is,
But I'm looking forward to it - one day,

div.head: Remembered Turf
div.p:
I’ve got the password
and I’m into the system.

lg.l: the other day at the coast…
to some jazzy kind of music,
It’s a beautiful day to be alive!
I have just stepped outside the building
and now I can quietly relax
and enjoy sitting on a bench
and quietly sip on my drink.
I walk outside into the glorious day.

div.head: My Brother. Oh brother...

lg.l: all caused by a combination of:
He has lots of good intentions
but I spend all my money
with not much to show for it,
and he has a wife and
If I mention on the phone
that I have to go down the street
half an hour telling me about
what ingredients to buy to make it
(and how good it will be for me) -
even though I tell him that
I could not be less interested in his recipe.

div.p: Oh brother!

div.head: Religion, sex, etc.

lg.l: I was touched by a Christian "anecdote",
for lack of a better thing to call it,
that a man talks to god and
I have been walking along a beach,
and I saw two sets of footprints,

div.p:
But in the worst times of my life
I only saw one set of footprints.

lg.l: Why did you abandon me God ?"

div.p:
You see I never abandoned you,
I was always there for you."
That story always gets me right there.

But basically
I don’t call myself a Christian.

lg.l: I don’t know if I believe in God,
there must be something after death.

div.p:
I believe that the souls of good people
end up in some kind of eternity,

I would not exactly describe it as heaven,
in the Christian definition.

lg.l: I believe that the Bible lays out
some very good ideals of how to live
live by being "nice" to each other
I guess I just don’t buy all of that
and miracles left, right and centre.
until I found out that they have,
I have a friend who I have an arrangement
to see when the want arises.

div.p:
She keeps telling me
that I am very special to her.

lg.l: but we know what we are doing and
we are both consenting adults and
that’s really all that needs to be said.
In the past I have been
embarrass me about my private life.
I don’t like what they did to me,
but I don’t despise them for it either.
I think that their actions only go
(because they have moved on to other jobs).

div.head: Pokies
div.p:
Here I am again
in the club.

Better to stop now
than later.

lg.l: therefore all poetry is lyric verse.
it is a blade of grass
therefore all things green are grass.

div.p: So I’ll hang onto it.

div.head: What is love ? #2
div.p:
Love is different things
for different people,

lg.l: who I only see now and then,
who I will never even know,
and what you think and do.

div.p:
so instead I dream on,
just loving life itself.

lg.l: And yes, I go on loving
Or is that just sex & lust ?

div.p: I need loving,
I need love,
I love loving,

but don’t ask me
what love is.

div.head: About the Poet
div.p: Peter Eric Williams was born on 1st of November, 1961, in Adelaide, South Australia, and grew up in places which include: Adelaide, Berri, Sydney, Oro Bay (Papua), Sydney (again), Canberra, Penang Island (Malaysia); before then returning with his family to Canberra, where he finished primary school, then High School and College, living in Lyneham. He then got a job with the Department of Defence, as a Trainee Draftsman, just before turning 20, where he continues to work to date (currently 1999), as a Technical Officer.

He has only recently taken up writing poetry. When he enrolled in a poetry workshop last year, with the ACT Writers’ Centre, he needed to bring a sample of his own poetry to the workshop, and he didn’t have any, so he wrote the poem which became "Nuts" (in a shortened form) in the evening before the workshop. It was warmly received in the workshop, and thus the germ of his poetry writing was planted and grew. He continues to share his poetry with fellow poets at the Closet Poets, who meet twice a month at the ACT Writers’ Centre, and also occassionally performs his work on radio 2XX.

Peter was diagnosed as a Schizophrenic approximately 15 years ago, and now leads a relatively "normal" life, with his full-time job, and on continual anti-psychotic medication. He lives in a rented, two bedroom flat in the Canberra suburb of Hawker, where in his spare time he uses his personal computer for the internet, programming and of course, writing poetry and publishing it on his own personal web page.

A large section of Peter’s poetry appears on his personal home page ( ). Some of Peter’s poetry currently appears on internet web site "The Australian BDSM Information Site" ( ), in the "short stories and poetry" section.

Peter said, "I hope that this poetry will: amuse, bemuse, entice, entertain, delight, shock, inform, educate and inspire the readers of these pages." Read this book and you will discover some of the quirky corners of his mind, about what turns him on, turns him off, and what turns him a little crazy…
